resources.string: Create shortcuts on your home screen to images or videos stored in a local device folder.
Share from gallery\nWhile viewing an image or video in the photo gallery, tap share and select Image Shortcut or Video Shortcut to create a home screen shortcut.

Add widget from home screen\nFrom the Add Widgets section of the home screen, scroll to Media Shortcut and select Image Shortcut or Video Shortcut.\nPick an image or video to create a homescreen shortcut.

On the home screen the shortcuts can be grouped into folders like icons.
This app is not required to view the images or videos. It could be uninstalled after creating the shortcut(s).
If the image or video is deleted, the shortcut remains but can no longer be opened.
To use this app, you must have a compatible photo gallery app installed to share, pick, crop and show the media.
Development of this app has cost several evenings and weekends.\nYet it is completely free and has no advertisements.
